svg.title: The serviceable line
svg.desc: Five bars, one per layer: Findable, Selectable, Integrable, Operable and Fixable, each as long as what the offering asks on that layer. Blue is how far your customers and their AI get on each; a white mark at the end of the blue is the serviceable line; past it, your people step in or the customer is lost. How far does your customer's AI get without you? A point of view by Etgar Bonar.
